content.src:
“起来了”“起来了”

一阵隐隐约约似乎从天外边传来的叫声把韩立从酣睡中惊醒，一睁眼一张硕大的脸紧紧的凑在眼前，韩立吃了一惊，把身子往后缩了缩，这才看清这张吓死了人的脸孔主人是另一名童子张铁
content.target:
"Get up" "Get up"

A faint call that seemed to come from far away woke Han Li from his deep sleep. As soon as he opened his eyes, a huge face was right in front of him. Han Li was startled and shrank back, only then realizing that the owner of this frightening face was another boy, Zhang Tie.

content.src: “快吃点东西吧，吃完晚饭要去见墨老那
content.target: "Hurry up and eat something. After dinner, we have to see Elder Mo."

content.src: ”张铁把两个还冒着热气的馒头递给了韩悝
content.target: Zhang Tie handed two still-steaming buns to Han Li.

content.src: “你从哪里找到的吃的
content.target: "Where did you find the food?"

content.src: ”韩立楞了一下，才接过食物
content.target: Han Li paused for a moment before taking the food.

content.src: “山谷附近有个大厨房，我看见所有的人都在那领吃的东西，便也去领了一份，吃完后才现你还没吃过那，又帮你领了两个馒头
content.target: "There's a big kitchen near the valley. I saw everyone getting food there, so I went to get some too. After eating, I realized you hadn't eaten yet, so I got two more buns for you."

content.src: ”张铁憨厚的冲韩悝笑了笑
content.target: Zhang Tie gave Han Li a simple, honest smile.

content.src: “多谢你了，张哥
content.target: "Thank you, Brother Zhang."

content.src: ”韩立心里有几分感动，见张铁长的比自己老成的多，一声“张哥”不禁脱口而出
content.target: Han Li felt touched. Seeing that Zhang Tie looked much older than him, the words "Brother Zhang" slipped out naturally.

content.src: “没……没事的，我在家里做惯了的，一会儿不干点升吗，总觉的心里有点有点不自在，以后有升吗要帮忙尽管开口说，我别的没有，力气还有一把的
content.target: "It's... it's nothing. I'm used to doing things at home. If I don't do something for a while, I feel a bit uneasy. If you ever need help with anything, just say the word. I may not have much, but I do have some strength."

content.src: ”张铁似乎有点不好意思了，说出的话也有些磕磕巴巴
content.target: Zhang Tie seemed a bit embarrassed, and his words came out somewhat stuttered.

content.src: 韩立早饭午饭都没吃，也有些饿急了，三五口一个馒头就进了肚子，才一小会儿的工夫，两个大馒头便彻底的消灭掉了
content.target: Han Li hadn't eaten breakfast or lunch and was quite hungry. He devoured a steamed bun in just a few bites, and in no time, two large buns were completely gone.

content.src: “时间不早了，我们去见墨老吧
content.target: "It's getting late. Let's go see Elder Mo."

content.src: ”韩立打了几个饱嗝，看了看窗外的落日，心里计算了下时间，觉的该去见墨大夫了
content.target: Han Li let out a few burps, glanced at the setting sun outside the window, and calculated the time in his mind, feeling it was time to visit Doctor Mo.

content.src: 张铁没有一点意见，跟着韩立来到了墨大夫所在的房内
content.target: Zhang Tie had no objections and followed Han Li into the room where Doctor Mo was.

content.src:
在墨大夫房内，四周墙壁边上，竖着一排排的书架，在书架上排满了密密麻麻的各类书籍，

“墨老
content.target: In Doctor Mo's room, rows of bookshelves lined the walls, filled with all kinds of books. "Elder Mo."

content.src:
”

“墨老
content.target: "Elder Mo."

content.src:
”

墨大夫背部紧挨着太师椅，手里拿着一本书正津津有味的看着，似乎完全没有注意到二人的到来，也没听到二人的招呼声
content.target: Doctor Mo leaned back in his armchair, engrossed in a book, seemingly unaware of their arrival or their greetings.

content.src: 韩立两人毕竟都是小孩，见墨大夫不理会二人，便变得不知所措，不知如何是好，只好站在一边干等着
content.target: Being just children, Han Li and Zhang Tie didn't know what to do when Doctor Mo ignored them, so they stood awkwardly to the side, waiting.

content.src:
直到韩立在一边站的脚都有点麻的时候，墨大夫才不慌不忙的把手里的书放到旁边的书桌上，冷冷地打量了两人一番，又端起了一杯茶，喝了几小口，才满吞吞地开口道：

“你二人从即日起便是我的记名弟子，我会教你们一些采药炼药的常识，也许还会教你们一些救人医人的医术，但决不会教你们武功
content.target: It wasn't until Han Li's feet began to feel numb from standing that Doctor Mo leisurely placed his book on the desk, gave them a cold look, sipped some tea, and finally spoke slowly: "From today onward, you two are my nominal disciples. I will teach you some basics about gathering and refining herbs, and perhaps some medical skills, but I will never teach you martial arts."

content.src: ”墨大夫面无表情，把手里的茶又放了下来
content.target: Doctor Mo showed no expression and put down the tea in his hand.

content.src: “我有一套修身养性的口诀要教你二人，虽然不能让你们克敌制胜，但也能让你们强身健体
content.target: "I have a set of meditation techniques to teach both of you. It won't help you defeat enemies, but it will improve your health."

content.src: 你们如果实在想学几手武功的话，可以去几位教习那里去学，我也不会反对，但半年后我考查的只是这套口诀的修炼情况，如果不合格，一样会被赶到外门去当外门弟子，你二人可听清楚了吗
content.target: "If you really want to learn some martial arts, you can go to the instructors. I won't stop you. But in six months, I will only test your progress in these techniques. If you fail, you'll be sent to the outer sect as disciples. Do you understand?"

content.src: ”墨大夫口气突然变的郑重起来，看起来对这套口诀非常重视
content.target: Doctor Mo's tone suddenly became serious, showing how much he valued these techniques.

content.src: “听清楚了
content.target: "We understand."

content.src: ”韩立二人异口同声的答到
content.target: Han Li and the other replied in unison.

content.src: “你二人出去吧，明天一早再来
content.target: "You two may leave now. Come back early tomorrow morning."

content.src: ”墨大夫冲两人摆了摆手，示意二人出去，又拿起那本书看了起来
content.target: Doctor Mo waved them away and picked up his book again.

content.src: 韩立出去前忍不住看了一眼墨大夫手里的书，可惜自己并不识字，只知书名是三个硕大的黑字
content.target: Before leaving, Han Li couldn't help but glance at the book in Doctor Mo's hand. Sadly, he couldn't read, only seeing three large black characters on the cover.

content.src: 可惜它们认识自己，自己不认识它们
content.target: Sadly, the words knew him, but he didn't know them.

content.src: 走出墨大夫的屋子，韩立不禁轻轻的松了一口气，刚才在屋里不知为升吗，自己连大气也不敢喘一下，脑子也绷得紧紧的，现在出来后马上就轻松起来，自己也恢复了正常
content.target: Stepping out of Dr. Mo's room, Han Li couldn't help but let out a soft sigh of relief. Inside, for some reason, he had been holding his breath and his mind was tense. Now that he was outside, he felt much more relaxed and back to normal.

content.src: 韩立在紧接着的几天里，一直兴奋不已，因为自己终于算是七玄门弟子了，虽然只是记名弟子但总比其他被送回家的童子强，即使自己半年后没能过关，也可以成为象三叔一样的外门弟子
content.target: In the following days, Han Li was extremely excited because he had finally become a disciple of the Seven Mysteries Sect, even if only a temporary one. This was still better than being sent home like the other children. Even if he failed the test in six months, he could still become an outer disciple like his Third Uncle.

content.src: 在韩立心目中三叔已经是非常有身份和地位的人，所以他心里并没有把半年后的考核放在心中，甚至心底下还隐隐约约希望自己没能过关，这样就可以早点出山见到父母和自己最疼爱的妹妹了
content.target: In Han Li's eyes, his Third Uncle was already a person of great status and position. So, he didn't worry much about the test in six months. In fact, he secretly hoped he would fail, so he could leave the mountains early and see his parents and beloved younger sister.

content.src: 随后的日子里，上午墨大夫传授给了他们一些医药方面的知识，下午让他们去一间书屋同其他童子一起学习识文断字和十二正经、奇经八脉、周身穴道方位等武学基础知识，并一起扎马步，打草人练些基本功夫
content.target: In the days that followed, Dr. Mo taught them some medical knowledge in the mornings. In the afternoons, they went to a study room with other children to learn reading, writing, and basic martial arts knowledge like the twelve main meridians, the eight extraordinary meridians, and the locations of acupoints. They also practiced horse stances and basic moves on straw dummies.

content.src: 一个月后，韩立二人和其他童子终于分开了，再也没有时间去学其他东西，因为墨大夫开始传授他们二人一套无名口诀，练习这套口决占用了他们大部分的时间，墨大夫并严令二人不得把口诀外传他人，如果泄露出去就要把他二人严加惩戒并踢出师门
content.target: A month later, Han Li and the other boy were separated from the rest of the children. They no longer had time to learn other things because Dr. Mo began teaching them a nameless chant. Practicing this chant took up most of their time. Dr. Mo strictly forbade them from sharing the chant with anyone else, warning that if they leaked it, they would be severely punished and expelled.

content.src: 在这期间，韩立通过其他人的口中对七玄门和墨大夫有了比较详细的了解
content.target: During this time, Han Li learned more about the Seven Mysteries Sect and Dr. Mo from others.

content.src: 七玄门有一位拥有七绝上人嫡传后人身份叫王6的正门主，和其他三位副门主，门内分为外门和内门两大部分
content.target: The Seven Mysteries Sect had one main leader, Wang Lu, who was a direct descendant of the Seven Supreme Masters, and three deputy leaders. The sect was divided into outer and inner branches.

content.src: 外门有飞鸟堂，聚宝堂，四海堂，外刃堂四个分堂，内门有百锻堂，七绝堂，供奉堂，血刃堂四个分堂，另外还有一个只在正门主之下和其他副门主并驾齐驱的长老会
content.target: The outer branch had four divisions: the Flying Bird Hall, the Treasure Gathering Hall, the Four Seas Hall, and the Outer Blade Hall. The inner branch had four divisions: the Hundred Forging Hall, the Seven Supreme Hall, the Offering Hall, and the Blood Blade Hall. There was also a Council of Elders, which ranked just below the main leader and equal to the deputy leaders.

content.src: 而墨大夫原本不是七玄门的弟子，只是在数年前，有一次王6门主在外出时不慎落入了敌人的圈套，被对头率众袭击，身受重伤，生命垂危，身边的众人都束手无策
content.target: Dr. Mo was not originally a disciple of the Seven Mysteries Sect. A few years ago, Leader Wang Lu had fallen into an enemy trap while traveling and was severely injured, near death. His followers were helpless, but they happened to meet Dr. Mo, a skilled physician.

content.src: 正好碰上了墨大夫这位医者，结果墨大夫妙手回春，药到病除，救下了王大门主的性命
content.target: Dr. Mo used his amazing medical skills to cure Leader Wang and save his life.

content.src: 王门主对墨大夫自然感激不禁，后来知道他除了医术高外竟然还有一身不弱的武功，便把他请回了门内
content.target: Sect Leader Wang was naturally very grateful to Doctor Mo. Later, he found out that besides being skilled in medicine, Doctor Mo also had considerable martial arts abilities. So, he invited him to join the sect.

content.src: 又在山里精心挑了一个小山谷，专门给他修了这片住宅，让墨大夫安心在七玄门落户，从而成了七玄门供奉堂的一名供奉
content.target: He also carefully selected a small valley in the mountains and built this residence specifically for Doctor Mo, allowing him to settle comfortably in the Seven Mysteries Sect. Thus, Doctor Mo became an honored elder in the sect's Hall of Offerings.

content.src: 墨大夫在七玄门的这段日子里，弟子们虽然没见过他的身手，不知道他武功的强弱，但他用那高明的医术救下了不少门内弟子的性命，因此他尽管经常面无表情、言语稀少，还是受到门内众弟子的尊敬
content.target: During his time in the Seven Mysteries Sect, the disciples never saw Doctor Mo's martial skills and didn't know how strong he was. However, his excellent medical skills saved many lives in the sect. Even though he often appeared expressionless and spoke little, he was still respected by all the disciples.
